The remaining files (.gitignore, .SRCINFO, LICENSE, REUSE.toml, .nvchecker.toml) are non-executable metadata. data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is an artifact of a tool/API failure. Qwen returned 'inconclusive' because it encountered HTTP 400 errors when trying to audit .gitignore, .SRCINFO, and LICENSE. DeepSeek successfully audited all files and returned 'safe'. There is no actual security disagreement between the models' reasoning.
coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to review .gitignore, .SRCINFO, and LICENSE due to HTTP 400 API errors.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient API errors (HTTP 400/500) so that a single model's failure doesn't force an inconclusive verdict when other models have successfully audited the package.
